title: The Door Is Real
subtitle: A Mara Vale investigation

Observation.2: Notice where the summary changes “account” into “Mara”. A change of noun can hide a change of certainty.
Observation.3: Compare project identifiers character by character. Matching identifiers link a commission and service; resemblance alone cannot.

Interviewing.2: Ask Rafi what the community misses. Return to him in the Archive or Porchlight.
Interviewing.3: Ask Elian what an honest boundary would sound like. Return to the Archive.

Systems.2: Ask the Oracle how verification scope works.
Systems.3: Ask the Arbiter how a provenance question becomes permission to review.

roles.name: Archivist
roles.text: You hold sources and decide custody. You cannot command consent.

roles.name: Oracle
roles.text: Interprets records and issues a bounded request; cannot certify a life.

roles.name: Arbiter
roles.text: Applies the standard that permits service review.

roles.name: Warden
roles.text: Enforces the mandate. A badge does not change it.

roles.name: Covenant
roles.text: Belonging: care and pressure to stay can coexist.

roles.name: Algorithm
roles.text: Distribution rewards engagement. Circulation is not corroboration.

roles.name: Exchange
roles.text: A commission turns continuity into a service.

roles.name: Silence
roles.text: Withholding can protect someone or suppress accountability.

roles.name: Devourer
roles.text: Escalating circulation can turn answers into spectacle.

roles.name: Eidolons / Proxies
roles.text: Synthetic origin and human operation are distinct. Neither appearance nor origin settles conduct.

roles.name: Returned / Lost
roles.text: Leaving and becoming unavailable are histories, not appearance tests.

roles.name: False Returned
roles.text: A presence used to counterfeit a return. This contextual use alone does not settle its inner experience.

roles.name: Cloud / Artifacts
roles.text: Retained fragments can outlast consent. Copies share ancestry.

roles.name: Origin Realm
roles.text: Embodied life beyond indexing. No location search is offered.

roles.name: Constructs / Echoes
roles.text: Reserved, unresolved terms. This chapter establishes no taxonomy.
